description: Read one Meridian Dispatch long-form dispatch or multi-day itinerary. A dispatch is a reported piece on one place: returns its headline, standfirst, opening excerpt, themes, publish date, photo and links to its town and country guides (the full text stays on the page). An itinerary is a country route over several days: returns the bases in order, nights in each, where to stay and every day's activities by part of the day, each linked to its guide. Use it only for these two kinds of page. For a country or town guide use get_destination; for one sight, trail, event or ski resort use get_place; to list dispatches on a theme use search_guides with type "dispatch" or "itinerary". Lookup order: an exact URL, then an exact slug, then the single best keyword match, so a place name returns the one most relevant dispatch. Read-only. No match returns an error message.

query.description: A dispatch or itinerary URL, its slug (e.g. "hallstatt", "montenegro-beach-six-days"), or the place it covers (e.g. "Hallstatt").
